text:
anya: heads up — code freeze at 15:00 UTC for the v1.12.4 ship. that's ~6 hours from now. please avoid non-critical merges after that. :rotating_light:
micah: quick q — i have a small patch that fixes a dependency bump (urllib) that would otherwise block prod tests. considered critical?
anya: if it’s just the dependency and it's low-risk, we can handle as late-merge exception. need a risk note, test evidence, and a rollback plan.
raj: fwiw the failing test in CI is flaky but reproducible locally for me. i can attach logs. want me to open the exception PR? @micah
micah: yes please. i'll add test logs. planning to bump from v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 in the PR.
samira: tagging QA — can we get a quick smoke run on staging once it's merged? we have a 30m window after the freeze for emergency verifications.
release-coordinator: process reminder: to request a late-merge exception, open a PR against `release/1.12` with the label `release/late-merge`, add `EXCEPTION.md` at the repo root with:
```
- author: <your-name>
- justification: <one-line rationale>
- risk: <low/med/high>
- rollback: <steps>
- test-evidence: <links>
```
Then ping #eng-releases and @release-coordinator. We'll triage within 15min.
deploy-bot: CI status: pipeline queued for #PR-4821. required checks: unit, integration, e2e. ETA ~12m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
micah: opened PR 4821, added EXCEPTION.md, labeled `release/late-merge`. CI green on unit tests, integration started. link: https://git.internal/pr/4821
ci-bot: integration failed on `redis-compat` test — flake suspected. rerunning: `./scripts/ci-retry --pr 4821`
raj: rerun passed. attaching quick runbook for rollback if we need to revert after merge:
```
1. `git checkout release/1.12`
2. `git revert -m 1 <merge-sha>`
3. open PR to revert and mark `release/rollback`
4. deploy revert through the normal release pipeline
```
anya: thanks — looks good. risk labeled low, tests + rollback present. approving exception. one ask: add a changelog entry under Unreleased -> Fixed with the dependency note.
micah: added changelog. smoke run on staging requested. @samira can you kick it when CI finishes?
samira: will run smoke after integration completes. ping me in thread once staging deploy is up.
deploy-bot: integration passed. building release candidate. staging deploy started. :rocket:
samira: smoke run OK (basic flows checked). no regressions spotted.
anya: merging PR now. reminder to coordinate any client SDK bumps after the cut — if we notice downstream issues, we have the 30m rollback window.
micah: merged. thx everyone. :tada:
release-coordinator: note for release notes: include dependency CVE note and that this was a late-merge exception approved by release lead.
anya: will draft release notes and post in #announcements after ship. closing thread after deploy completes. :white_check_mark:
